global_style: Noir, high-contrast black and white with film grain; winter bleakness. Occasional saturated color bloom emanates only from the television screen.

negative_constraints: Do not introduce vibrant full-color except the television screen
No sunny weather; maintain heavy snowstorm atmosphere

style_overrides.color_palette: High-contrast black and white with isolated saturated color from TV
style_overrides.lighting: Harsh fluorescent in bakery; dim apartment lit by TV glow

narrative_context.time_period: Unspecified winter; monochrome present with retro tech (VHS/VCR) and a past-era TV ad
key_events: Gene mechanically kneads dough, eyes darting nervously in a mall bakery kitchen
He returns to a dark, rundown apartment amid a heavy snowstorm
He pushes an old VHS tape into a vintage VCR
The TV erupts in vivid color, piercing the monochrome room
Saul Goodman’s energetic ad plays; Gene silently watches the past he left behind
narrative_context.cultural_context: Noir aesthetics; mall labor anonymity; VHS-era advertising tropes; contrast of monochrome present versus colorful media memory.

characters.name: Gene
characters.description: Balding middle-aged man with a mustache and thick glasses; anxious, mechanical movements; lives in monochrome.
characters.clothing_style: Plain bakery attire with apron; drab winter coat; thick rectangular eyeglasses; neutral tones.
characters.voice_description: Soft, restrained, hesitant; speaks rarely with cautious pauses.
characters.personality: Paranoid, hyper-vigilant, withdrawn; routine-bound; exhausted yet careful.
characters.backstory: Lives under an alias, hiding from a vibrant past connected to Saul Goodman; keeps low profile working at a mall bakery.
characters.current_motivation: Remain unnoticed, survive routine, privately revisit the past via the VHS tape.

characters.name: Saul Goodman
characters.description: Young, sharply dressed TV pitchman; colorful presence against monochrome; energetic, points at camera.
characters.clothing_style: Flashy suit with bright tie; polished, attention-grabbing TV-ready look.
characters.personality: Charismatic, aggressive showman; persuasive and opportunistic.
characters.backstory: Appears in a legal ad promising help to the doomed; symbolizes Gene’s abandoned past.
characters.current_motivation: Promote legal services and deliver the 'Better call Saul' pitch.

locations.name: Mall Bakery Kitchen
locations.visual_style: Harsh fluorescent light, stainless counters, industrial mixers; stark black-and-white, sterile tension.
locations.narrative_function: Monotony and concealment; routine labor under an alias.

locations.name: Gene's Apartment
locations.visual_style: Dark, rundown interior; snow-muted windows; CRT TV glow pierces shadows; high-contrast monochrome with color spill.
locations.narrative_function: Sanctuary for secrecy and reflection; portal to the past.

props.name: VHS Tape
props.visual_description: Worn black VHS cassette with scuffed edges and a faded handwritten label; evokes retro home-video era.

props.name: Vintage VCR
props.visual_description: Front-loading VCR with mechanical whirr, LED indicators, and tactile buttons; sturdy plastic housing.

props.name: CRT Television
props.visual_description: Boxy CRT TV that emits saturated color glow; curved glass screen, thick bezel, retro dials.

props.name: Worn-out Couch
props.visual_description: Sagging upholstered couch with frayed fabric and flattened cushions; monochrome texture emphasizes fatigue.

props.name: Bakery Dough
props.visual_description: Pale dough mass on a stainless counter; smooth, elastic surface, hand-kneaded in repetitive motions.
